title: Kyc Cdd Form
description: Kyc Cdd Form contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-kyc-cdd-form
  title: Kyc Cdd Form
  description: Kyc Cdd Form contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_kyc_cdd_form_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/kyc_cdd_form
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/kyc_cdd_form
    sourceVersion: fs_kyc_cdd_form_v1
    sourceDigest: 3de4cb6c0afdbabac2d41812f9a1af79c94559102e5df02307e9d753425558a8
spec:
  role: review
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Kyc Cdd Form
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: date-of-birth
              name: date_of_birth
              label: Date Of Birth
              description: Date of birth
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: id-expiration-date
              name: id_expiration_date
              label: Id Expiration Date
              description: Id expiration date
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: review-date
              name: review_date
              label: Review Date
              description: Review date
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: city
              name: city
              label: City
              description: City
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: state
              name: state
              label: State
              description: State
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: postal-code
              name: postal_code
              label: Postal Code
              description: Postal code
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: country
              name: country
              label: Country
              description: Country
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: phone
              name: phone
              label: Phone
              description: Phone
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: email
              name: email
              label: Email
              description: Email
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: occupation-or-business
              name: occupation_or_business
              label: Occupation Or Business
              description: Occupation or business
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: source-of-funds
              name: source_of_funds
              label: Source Of Funds
              description: Source of funds
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: expected-monthly-activity
              name: expected_monthly_activity
              label: Expected Monthly Activity
              description: Expected monthly activity
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: id-document-type
              name: id_document_type
              label: Id Document Type
              description: Id document type
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: id-document-number-masked
              name: id_document_number_masked
              label: Id Document Number Masked
              description: Id document number masked
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: tax-id-masked
              name: tax_id_masked
              label: Tax Id Masked
              description: Tax id masked
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: customer-name
              name: customer_name
              label: Customer Name
              description: Customer name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: customer-type
              name: customer_type
              label: Customer Type
              description: Individual | Business | Trust | Other
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: beneficial-owner-name
              name: beneficial_owner_name
              label: Beneficial Owner Name
              description: Beneficial owner name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: beneficial-owner-ownership-percent
              name: beneficial_owner_ownership_percent
              label: Beneficial Owner Ownership Percent
              description: Beneficial owner ownership percent
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: reviewer-name
              name: reviewer_name
              label: Reviewer Name
              description: Reviewer name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: address-line1
              name: address_line1
              label: Address Line1
              description: Address line1
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: risk-rating
              name: risk_rating
              label: Risk Rating
              description: Low | Medium | High
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: pep-status
              name: pep_status
              label: Pep Status
              description: Pep status
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: customer-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Customer name is required for KYC onboarding and screening.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: customer_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: customer_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: customer_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(customer_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: customer-type-valid-enum
      severity: error
      description: Customer type must be a supported onboarding category.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: customer_type
            right:
              value: Individual
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: customer_type
            right:
              value: Business
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: customer_type
            right:
              value: Trust
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: customer_type
            right:
              value: Other
      sourceExpression: customer_type IN ('Individual', 'Business', 'Trust', 'Other')
      supported: true
    - id: risk-rating-valid-enum
      severity: warning
      description: Risk rating should use the expected CDD categories.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: risk_rating
          - op: or
            rules:
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: risk_rating
                right:
                  value: Low
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: risk_rating
                right:
                  value: Medium
              - op: eq
                left:
                  field: risk_rating
                right:
                  value: High
      sourceExpression: risk_rating IS NULL OR risk_rating IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High')
      supported: true
    - id: beneficial-owner-percent-range
      severity: warning
      description: Ownership percentage must be within 0-100 when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: beneficial_owner_ownership_percent
          - op: and
            rules:
              - op: gt
                left:
                  field: beneficial_owner_ownership_percent
                right:
                  value: 0
              - op: lte
                left:
                  field: beneficial_owner_ownership_percent
                right:
                  value: 100
      sourceExpression: beneficial_owner_ownership_percent IS NULL OR (beneficial_owner_ownership_percent > 0 AND
        beneficial_owner_ownership_percent <= 100)
      supported: true
    - id: review-date-present
      severity: warning
      description: CDD records should include review or certification date.
      rule:
        op: present
        field: review_date
      sourceExpression: review_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      customer_name:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Primary identity field for CIP and sanctions screening.
      customer_type:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Controls individual versus entity onboarding workflow.
      tax_id_masked:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Masked tax identifier supports CIP matching without storing full sensitive value.
      risk_rating:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Risk rating drives ongoing monitoring cadence.
      beneficial_owner_name:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Beneficial owner identity is required for covered legal entity CDD.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-dbrx-instruct
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-sonnet
    maxTokens: 2048
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: KYC/CDD forms are moderately structured onboarding documents with labeled identity, risk, and
      beneficial ownership fields. DBRX Instruct is sufficient for low-latency structured extraction; Claude
      Sonnet is retained for entity ownership edge cases or degraded scans.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      customer_name:
        type: string
        description: Customer name
      customer_type:
        type: string
        description: Individual | Business | Trust | Other
      date_of_birth:
        type: string
        description: Date of birth
      tax_id_masked:
        type: string
        description: Tax id masked
      address_line1:
        type: string
        description: Address line1
      city:
        type: string
        description: City
      state:
        type: string
        description: State
      postal_code:
        type: string
        description: Postal code
      country:
        type: string
        description: Country
      phone:
        type: string
        description: Phone
      email:
        type: string
        description: Email
      occupation_or_business:
        type: string
        description: Occupation or business
      source_of_funds:
        type: string
        description: Source of funds
      expected_monthly_activity:
        type: string
        description: Expected monthly activity
      risk_rating:
        type: string
        description: Low | Medium | High
      pep_status:
        type: string
        description: Pep status
      beneficial_owner_name:
        type: string
        description: Beneficial owner name
      beneficial_owner_ownership_percent:
        type: number
        description: Beneficial owner ownership percent
      id_document_type:
        type: string
        description: Id document type
      id_document_number_masked:
        type: string
        description: Id document number masked
      id_expiration_date:
        type: date
        description: Id expiration date
        format: date
      review_date:
        type: date
        description: Review date
        format: date
      reviewer_name:
        type: string
        description: Reviewer name
    required:
      - customer_name
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - customer_name
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - property_or_asset
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
